title.zh: 如何关闭启动时的版权弹窗
title.en: How to turn off the startup notice

body.zh:
进入「设置 → 应用信息 → 高级设置」，把「关闭启动前弹窗」打开即可，之后每次启动都不再显示这个版权弹窗。
同一个页面还可以关闭「启动时检查公告」和「启动时自动检查更新」。
body.en:
Open Settings → About → Advanced settings and switch on “Disable startup notice” — it will stop appearing on every launch.
The same page also lets you turn off “Check announcements at startup” and “Check for updates at startup”.
